blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Unidentified motorcycle riding gunmen ambushed and killed a retired soldier in Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte at past 3 p.m. Monday, Nov. 16. Lt. Colonel Brian Balite, Datu Odin Sinsuat municipal police station chief, identified the victim as Danny Alif Lakim, 68, a resident of Poblacion Salbu, Datu Saudi Ampatuan, Maguindanao del Sur. The ambush occurred at 3:45 p.m. along the national highway in Barangay Kurintem.
